Dear Deepika,

Thank you for reaching out and for your interest in this opportunity.

You are welcome to complete the AI interview at your convenience using the link from your original invitation email. There is no fixed schedule for the AI interview, so you may take it at any time.

If you are unable to find the original link, please let us know and we will be happy to resend it.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,
